description: AOSP Dealers is a greenfield platform built for AmeriCasa dealer operations, designed to streamline workflow and maximize operational efficiency. Developed from scratch as a next-generation tool, it replaced legacy systems with modern Angular architecture.

challenge.title: Building a modern dealer operations platform from scratch that improves workflow efficiency and reduces operational friction.
challenge.description: Dealers were operating with outdated systems that introduced friction into their daily workflows. The challenge was architecting a brand new platform that not only modernized the technology stack, but fundamentally improved operational efficiency. This meant understanding dealer workflows deeply, anticipating pain points, and designing a UI that made complex operations intuitive. Performance was critical—dealers needed instant feedback and responsiveness.

solution.title: Architecting a greenfield dealer platform with Angular Reactive Forms, achieving 10% performance improvement in AmeriCasa operations.
solution.description: I led the frontend development of AOSP Dealers as a complete greenfield project. By starting fresh, I had the opportunity to implement modern Angular patterns from day one, including sophisticated form management with Angular Reactive Forms for handling complex dealer workflows. The data-driven UI ensured information was presented contextually and intuitively. Through careful performance optimization, the platform delivered 10% efficiency gains for AmeriCasa dealers—measurable time savings in their daily operations. The codebase was built on solid foundations with TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier enforcing quality throughout. The result is a platform that dealers actively prefer using, a testament to thoughtful engineering and user-focused development.
